tex_content.label: lfunctionandsurgerysection
tex_content.html:
Let $\M $ be a Ricci flow with surgery, and fix a point $(x_0,t_0)\in \M $. One may define the $\L $-length of an admissible curve $\ga $ from $(x_0,t_0)$ to some $(x,t)$, for $t<t_0$, using the formula

\begin{equation} \L (\ga )=\int _t^{t_0}\sqrt{t_0-\bar t}\, \left(R+|\dot{\ga }|^2\right)d\bar t, \end{equation}
